602: ############################

604: # The final signature is selected only from GSE151371 stability analysis.

694: expr_genes <- rownames(fit151$v$E)
695: 
696: innate_pool_present <- intersect(innate_candidate_pool, expr_genes)
697: adaptive_pool_present <- intersect(adaptive_candidate_pool, expr_genes)

720: for (b in seq_len(B)) {
721:   if (b %% 25 == 0) {
722:     message("Stability iteration: ", b, " / ", B)
723:   }
724: 
725:   sampled_samples <- unlist(lapply(levels(meta151$group), function(g) {
726:     ss <- meta151$sample[meta151$group == g]
727:     n_take <- max(2, floor(length(ss) * subsample_fraction))
728:     sample(ss, n_take, replace = FALSE)
729:   }))
730: 
731:   counts_b <- counts151[, sampled_samples, drop = FALSE]
732:   meta_b <- meta151[match(sampled_samples, meta151$sample), , drop = FALSE]
733: 
734:   fit_b <- tryCatch(
735:     run_voom_limma(counts_b, meta_b),
736:     error = function(e) NULL
737:   )
738: 
739:   if (is.null(fit_b)) {
740:     next
741:   }
742: 
743:   tt_primary <- top_table_all(fit_b$fit, "SCI_vs_TC")
744:   tt_support <- top_table_all(fit_b$fit, "SCI_vs_HC")

749:   # Innate: higher in SCI than TC and directionally higher than HC.
750:   innate_present_b <- intersect(innate_pool_present, rownames(tt_primary))
751:   innate_df <- data.frame(
752:     gene = innate_present_b,
753:     logFC_primary = tt_primary[innate_present_b, "logFC"],
754:     p_primary = tt_primary[innate_present_b, "P.Value"],
755:     logFC_support = tt_support[innate_present_b, "logFC"],
756:     stringsAsFactors = FALSE
757:   )
758: 
759:   innate_df$direction_ok <- innate_df$logFC_primary > 0 & innate_df$logFC_support > 0
760:   innate_df <- innate_df[order(innate_df$p_primary), , drop = FALSE]
761:   selected_innate <- head(innate_df$gene[innate_df$direction_ok], top_n_per_module_per_iteration)
762: 
763:   # Adaptive: lower in SCI than TC and directionally lower than HC.
764:   adaptive_present_b <- intersect(adaptive_pool_present, rownames(tt_primary))
765:   adaptive_df <- data.frame(
766:     gene = adaptive_present_b,
767:     logFC_primary = tt_primary[adaptive_present_b, "logFC"],
768:     p_primary = tt_primary[adaptive_present_b, "P.Value"],
769:     logFC_support = tt_support[adaptive_present_b, "logFC"],
770:     stringsAsFactors = FALSE
771:   )
772: 
773:   adaptive_df$direction_ok <- adaptive_df$logFC_primary < 0 & adaptive_df$logFC_support < 0
774:   adaptive_df <- adaptive_df[order(adaptive_df$p_primary), , drop = FALSE]
775:   selected_adaptive <- head(adaptive_df$gene[adaptive_df$direction_ok], top_n_per_module_per_iteration)

813: stability_record$selection_frequency <- stability_record$selected_n / B
814: stability_record$direction_consistency <- stability_record$direction_correct_n / pmax(stability_record$tested_n, 1)

839: lock_module <- function(stab, module_name) {
840:   d <- stab[stab$module == module_name, , drop = FALSE]
841: 
842:   if (module_name == "innate") {
843:     direction_full_ok <- d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_TC > 0 & d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_HC > 0
844:   } else {
845:     direction_full_ok <- d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_TC < 0 & d$full_logFC_SCI_vs_HC < 0
846:   }
847: 
848:   locked <- d[
849:     d$selection_frequency >= min_selection_frequency &
850:       d$direction_consistency >= min_direction_consistency &
851:       direction_full_ok,
852:     ,
853:     drop = FALSE
854:   ]
855: 
856:   locked <- locked[order(
857:     -locked$selection_frequency,
858:     -locked$direction_consistency,
859:     locked$full_FDR_SCI_vs_TC
860:   ), , drop = FALSE]
861: 
862:   if (nrow(locked) < min_genes_per_module) {
863:     warning(
864:       "Fewer than ", min_genes_per_module,
865:       " genes passed strict threshold for ", module_name,
866:       ". Falling back to top-ranked stable direction-consistent genes."
867:     )
868: 
869:     fallback <- d[direction_full_ok, , drop = FALSE]
870:     fallback <- fallback[order(
871:       -fallback$selection_frequency,
872:       -fallback$direction_consistency,
873:       fallback$full_FDR_SCI_vs_TC
874:     ), , drop = FALSE]
875: 
876:     locked <- head(fallback, min_genes_per_module)
877:   }
878: 
879:   head(locked, max_genes_per_module)
880: }
881: 
882: locked_innate <- lock_module(stability_record, "innate")
883: locked_adaptive <- lock_module(stability_record, "adaptive")

943: score151_innate <- control_referenced_z_score(
944:   expr = expr151,
945:   meta = data.frame(sample = meta151$sample, group = meta151$group, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
946:   genes = locked_innate$gene,
947:   ref_group = "TC"
948: )
949: 
950: score151_adaptive <- control_referenced_z_score(
951:   expr = expr151,
952:   meta = data.frame(sample = meta151$sample, group = meta151$group, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
953:   genes = locked_adaptive$gene,
954:   ref_group = "TC"
955: )
956: 
957: scores151 <- data.frame(
958:   sample = colnames(expr151),
959:   group = as.character(meta151$group),
960:   innate_score = as.numeric(score151_innate$score[colnames(expr151)]),
961:   adaptive_score = as.numeric(score151_adaptive$score[colnames(expr151)]),
962:   stringsAsFactors = FALSE
963: )
964: 
965: scores151$balance_score <- scores151$innate_score - scores151$adaptive_score
